# sigil-ui

> Svelte 5 (runes) component library. CSS framework agnostic: every component
> consumes the --sig-* CSS variable contract and merges a class prop, so
> Tailwind v4, UnoCSS, Panda CSS or plain CSS can theme it. Zero runtime
> component dependencies. Machine-readable metadata: /manifest.json.

## Docs

- [Full component docs](llms-full.txt): props, classes, data attributes, examples
- [Token contract](#tokens): every --sig-* variable with light and dark defaults
- [Component manifest](manifest.json): structured JSON for agents

## Components

- Button: Button with variant styling driven by data-variant and the --sig-* token contract.
- Badge: Inline status label.
- Switch: Toggle using role=switch and aria-checked.
- Input: Styled native text input.
- Select: Styled native select with a chevron affordance.
- Checkbox: Styled native checkbox.
- Avatar: Round avatar with image and initials fallback.
- Progress: Progress bar with role=progressbar and aria value wiring.
- Skeleton: Loading placeholder block with a pulse animation.
- Alert: Inline message with tone colors.
- Separator: Horizontal or vertical rule.
- Stat: Dashboard metric: uppercase label, large value, optional signed delta colored by direction.
- Tooltip: Hover and focus tooltip.
- Card: Surface namespace: Root, Header, Title, Description, Content, Footer.
- Tabs: Tabs namespace: Root (bindable value), List, Trigger, Content.
- Accordion: Accordion namespace: Root, Item (value), Trigger, Content.
- Dialog: Modal dialog namespace: Root (bindable open), Trigger, Portal, Overlay, Content, Title, Description, Close.
- Toaster: Toast system.
- PaneGroup: Resizable split panes (PaneGroup, Pane, PaneResizer).

## Adapters

- Tailwind CSS v4: sigil-ui/tailwind.css
- UnoCSS: sigil-ui/uno
- Panda CSS: sigil-ui/panda
- No framework: sigil-ui/theme.css

## Install

```
pnpm add sigil-ui
import 'sigil-ui/theme.css'
```
